Contest of Champions is an arena where you can pit your favorite character against your friends... or your enemies. Characters who enter will be divided into teams to fight to the death. 
WARNING: All plot specific items will be stripped when the players enter this module.

Server Requirements: Make sure the 'Only One Party' button in the server's advanced options is off.
